courses.deskripsi: This module covers the most fundamental rules for forming English sentences, perfect for beginners.

lessons.konten_teks:
An Article is a word used to modify a noun. There are two types of articles: Definite (The) and Indefinite (A/An). A is used before a noun starting with a consonant sound, while An is used before a vowel sound.

Examples: A car, An apple, The sun.
A Pronoun is used to replace a noun to avoid word repetition. Examples of basic pronouns are I, You, They, We, He, She, It.
